https://www.wired.com/story/meta-refused.new_action: A second UK regulator, the Financial Conduct Authority, publicly said Meta declined its request to jointly test the Muse agent before the UK launch. The FCA is seeking to understand how the agent makes payments and acts autonomously. The 11-25 card was the ICO's data-protection statement.

items.title: American SI Exports Program; On-Demand Consortia for Specific Foreign Opportunities (Commerce/ITA notice)
items.source: Federal Register (U.S. Department of Commerce, ITA)
items.rationale: AI geopolitics, primary document: Commerce opens an On-Demand Consortia pathway under the EO 14320 SI Exports Program. From Nov 30, industry consortia can apply to have full-stack US AI export packages designated for specific foreign deals.
items.excerpt: Commerce's International Trade Administration sets up an On-Demand Consortia pathway under the Super Intelligence (SI) Exports Program created by EO 14320, so industry consortia can apply from Nov 30 to have full-stack US AI export packages designated for specific foreign opportunities. It also adds re-designation/de-designation rules and plans to reopen the Pre-Set Consortia pathway. (Filed for public inspection 11-25 08:45 ET; published in the FR 11-27.)

items.title: 공정위, 애플 '시리' AI기능 지연…부당광고 혐의 심의 착수
items.rationale: AI regulation, enforcement: the KFTC examiner's report alleging Apple advertised Apple Intelligence features as usable before they shipped went to the full commission. It proposes a fine based on 3.35 trillion won in related sales. Apple disputes the findings.
items.excerpt: 공정위 심사관이 애플·애플코리아가 아이폰16 판매 때 제공 시기가 불확실한 '애플 인텔리전스' AI 기능(개인 맥락 시리 등 4개)을 정상 이용 가능한 것처럼 광고했다며 표시광고법 위반 심사보고서를 24일 위원회에 상정했다. 관련 매출액 3조3527억원 기준 과징금 의견을 냈고, 애플은 결론에 동의하지 않는다는 입장이다.

items.title: Spanish opposition criticised for AI video of Pedro Sánchez in Morocco shirt
items.rationale: AI in elections: an AI-altered campaign clip posted without disclosure days before Spain's general election. Critics cited by the Guardian say it may fall short of EU AI Act Article 50 transparency duties. It is an early real-world test of the deepfake-labelling rule.
items.excerpt: Spain's People's Party posted an AI-altered version of a Sánchez campaign clip making it appear he put on a Morocco shirt, without any AI disclosure, prompting criticism that it may fall short of EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations days before Sunday's general election.

items.title: 산자위, 산업 AI전환·활용 촉진법안(M.AX법) 의결…제조업 지원
items.rationale: Legislation, committee vote: the Assembly industry committee passed the Industrial AI Transformation Act (M.AX Act) by cross-party agreement. It gives a legal basis to the manufacturing AI alliance and tacit-knowledge data support, and the bill now moves to the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and then the plenary.
items.excerpt: 국회 산자위가 26일 전체회의에서 '산업 인공지능 전환 및 활용 촉진법'(M.AX법)을 여야 합의로 의결했다. 제조업 AI 전환 얼라이언스와 암묵지 데이터 지원사업의 법적 근거를 마련했고, 외국인투자 안보심의 근거 신설 등도 함께 의결돼 법사위·본회의로 넘어간다.

items.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
items.rationale: Agent regulation, follow-up: after the ICO's 11-25 statement, the FCA now says Meta declined joint pre-launch testing of the Muse agent. The FCA wants to understand how the agent makes payments and acts autonomously, which signals scrutiny of payment-capable agents.
items.excerpt: The UK Financial Conduct Authority said Meta declined its request for joint testing of the Muse personal AI agent before its UK launch; the FCA wants to understand how agents make payments and act autonomously in consumers' interest.
